description_en: Calls UpdateDataDispatchConfig to update the data forwarding configuration of a node group
description_zh: 调用UpdateDataDispatchConfig更新节点分组的数据流转配置
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan update-data-dispatch-config --node-group-id 123 --data-dispatch-destination IOT --product-type IOT_SUITE --product-name '产品1' --product-key xxxxxxxx --uplink-region-name cn-beijing --uplink-topic cn-shanghai --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataDispatchConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group to update
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The data forwarding destination. Valid values:

IOT: forwards data to an IoT product.
ONS: forwards data to an MQ topic
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地。取值：

IOT：数据流转到IoT的产品。
ONS：数据流转到MQ的Topic
parameters.name: data_dispatch_destination

parameters.help_en:
The IoT product type when the data forwarding destination is IoT. Valid values:

IOT_SUITE: forwards data to IoT Suite Basic Edition.
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR: forwards data to IoT Suite Pro Edition
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地为IoT的产品类型。取值：

IOT_SUITE：数据流转到 IoT 套件基础版。
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR：数据流转到 IoT 套件高级版
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the IoT product when the data forwarding destination is IoT
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为IoT的产品名称
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en: The product key when the data forwarding destination is IoT
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为IoT的Product Key
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The uplink region ID when the data forwarding destination is MQ
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为MQ的上行Region Id
parameters.name: uplink_region_name

parameters.help_en: The uplink topic when the data forwarding destination is MQ
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为MQ的上行Topic
parameters.name: uplink_topic

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
